systems: Helm chart versions (SemVer 2): a pre-release such as 1.2.0-rc.1 sorts BELOW 1.2.0, and helm picks the newest stable unless --devel is passed
Cargo / crates.io: a requirement like ^1.33 never selects 1.33.0-rc.1 unless the pre-release is named, so the newest release is the newest without a suffix
GitHub Releases: a release marked prerelease is not returned as latest by the releases/latest endpoint
